SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   D. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

7. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

14. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

15. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   C. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Language groups in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
